## Try FruitMeasureApp

- Download the app and start measuring fruit size directly from your smartphone.
- You can try the app with test images, without needing to print the support or capture images in the field. Download them at the following link:

::: {.resource-cta-group}
[Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.anphis.es.fruit_measure_app){.btn-store .btn-store--outline}
[Apple Store](https://apps.apple.com/es/app/fruitmeasureapp/id6758163918){.btn-store .btn-store--outline}
[Download test images →](../assets/app/imatges_test_app.zip){.btn-store .btn-store--outline}
:::

## Explore the AI model {style="text-align:center;"}

::: {.model-intro}
The app uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) for fruit detection and segmentation, combined with geometric calibration using a reference marker.
:::

::: {.model-columns}

::: {}
**Pipeline:** Calibrate → Capture → Detect → Measure

## Run inference mode Fruit

```bash
python main.py --mode Fruit --image example_images/IMG_20240828_122454.jpg
```

## Run inference mode Cluster

```bash
python main.py --mode Cluster --image example_images/IMG_20240828_122454.jpg
```
:::

::: {}

## Optional Arguments

::: {.code-tag}
--dist_fruit2cam
:::

Distance (mm) from fruit to camera (default: 250 mm)

## Output

::: {.output-row}
[*_results.csv]{.code-tag} → The diameter plus the confidence
:::
::: {.output-row}
[*_mask_dets.jpg]{.code-tag} → Segmentation
:::
::: {.output-row}
[*_bb_dets.jpg]{.code-tag} → Create the bounding boxes
:::
